about: Shared story bank for the reading games (Story Order, Read & Remember, True or False Race, Spot the Mistakes). 5 sentences per story, in order. tf: statements (a = true/false, fix = the correct fact). questions: short answers. mistakes: in sentence i, the right word(s) are swapped for a wrong form (Spot the Mistakes). Written for Kru in American English. At least 50 stories per level, shuffled every game. M.4 = harder stories (Henry, Nov 10): Read & Remember, Story Order and Spot the Mistakes show stories one level up (M.1 uses M.2, M.2 uses M.3, M.3 uses M.4); True or False Race is unchanged. Read & Remember questions go easy, medium, hard.
